name: Typographic architecture

source.description: An inspected square kinetic-type piece (batch 1, 2026-11-26) builds a sentence into a structure: a beam that sags under a word, words hanging from it, rotated words as pillars and a top line as the floor.

technique: Words become structural members of a building that the sentence constructs: a heavy word rests on a thin beam that bends under its weight, a word hangs from the beam on hangers, a word rotated 90 degrees becomes a pillar, and the last line sets the floor or roof. The structure is the argument.
purpose: Make an abstract statement physical (pressure, support, holding up, making room); a quote or manifesto as an object.
visual_behaviour: A gold hairline under a giant word bows downward; small serif phrases hang beneath; the camera reframes as each member is added; the final frame is a portal of two 'pillar' words under a top line.
mechanics: Lay out on a grid: beam as an SVG path whose sag (quadratic control point) scales with the weight of the word placed on it, settling with a damped oscillation (elastic.out) when the word lands; hangers as 1 px lines drawn top-down; pillar words rotated -90/90 degrees with transform-origin at their base and dropped into place; small serif connectors type in between. Camera: Studio.space.panTo to the newest member. Transitions inside the piece: push the view up off a word; zoom through a letter counter.

decomposition.timing: One member every 1.5-3 s; beam settle 0.4-0.6 s.

parameters.name: sag
parameters.description: Beam deflection per unit of word weight in --u

parameters.name: members
parameters.description: Ordered list of {word, role: beam-load | hanger | pillar | floor}

use_cases: abstract ideas in history or civics (who holds up what)
failure_modes: Structure that does not match the meaning becomes decoration
Rotated words become hard to read; keep them short and large
Too many members crowd a square frame

implementation.approach: Hand-placed layout per piece with GSAP: beam path attr d tween for the sag, rotation tweens for pillars, line draws for hangers, Studio.space.panTo for reframing.

provenance.observed: 'WAIT' sits on a gold hairline that bows under it; 'WAITING' hangs from the line on thin hangers; 'VOICE' rotates into a left pillar, a second 'VOICE' forms the right one, and a top line completes the portal.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from a user-supplied reference (inspiration-only, rights unknown). No copy or layout is reused.
